title: Stable Diffusion Deforum Subtitle
description:

Scenes:
```{
    "0": "Stunning view of the Milky Way galaxy, millions of stars shining brightly, cosmic wonder",
    "30": "Zooming in on a distant star cluster, intricate details of celestial bodies revealed",
    "60": "A meteor shower lights up the night sky, streaks of brilliance across the Milky Way",
    "90": "Silhouettes of trees against the Milky Way backdrop, tranquil night in the wilderness"
}
```
